project_context.name: Carlos Sibaja
project_context.theme: Dark mode default, electric cyan/teal accent
project_context.vibe: Sleek, high-tech, minimal, professional, modern floating UI

layout_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment, strictly left-aligned text blocks for engineering precision (avoid center disease).

hero.style: High-tech precise layout. Name large (h1). Job title as glowing mono-spaced label. Short statement.
hero.motion: Staggered fade-up entrance for text. Background parallax.

navigation.style: Sticky top, glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/70`), 1px border-b border-cyan-400/10.
navigation.behavior: Visible links on desktop, avoid hamburger unless strictly mobile.

project_cards.style: Floating interactive cards. `bg-slate-900` with `border border-cyan-400/20` and max `rounded-lg`. Subtle float animation. Image takes up top half, mono-spaced tags at bottom.

case_study_modal.style: Centered floating panel. `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center`. Scrim `bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md`.
case_study_modal.panel: bg-slate-900 border border-cyan-400/30 rounded-xl w-[95vw] sm:w-[90vw] max-w-5xl max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,229,255,0.05)]
case_study_modal.content: Vertically scrolling. Large hero image, one-line summary, problem/goal, my role, steps (bento grid layout for steps), prototype images, result/lesson.
case_study_modal.behavior: Scroll isolated to inner container. X close button fixed to top-right of the modal panel. Background stays fixed.

journey_timeline.style: Vertical timeline. `w-px bg-slate-800` track. Nodes are glowing cyan dots. Items staggered left/right or inline on mobile.

resume_contact.style: Clean block layout. Pill-shaped download button (`bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 hover:bg-cyan-300 font-bold px-8 py-4`).
resume_contact.content: No contact form. Display email directly as a large typography interactive link, plus LinkedIn link.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/70`) for overlays. Solid sharp or slightly rounded corners (`max 8px`) for project cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital noise overlay (`mix-blend-overlay opacity-5`) or scanlines to emulate CAD/terminal vibes without going full retro.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Use `drop-shadow` or tailored `box-shadow` with cyan tint to create a glowing LED/Laser aesthetic in a deep dark room.

patterns: Hover states: transform -translate-y-1, transition-transform duration-300 ease-out
Floating: y: [0, -8, 0] repeating animation for cards or hero imagery
Page load: Staggered entrance for hero elements (`delay: 0.1` increments)
Modal: Animate presence from scale 0.95 and opacity 0 to scale 1 and opacity 1

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Use `text-slate-50` against `slate-900/950`. Cyan (`#00E5FF`) used for accents/borders; ensure text ON cyan buttons is dark (`text-slate-950`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="nav-home"`, `data-testid="project-card-1"`, `data-testid="resume-download-btn"`, `data-testid="modal-close-btn"`).

hero_background.description: Dark mechanical gears. Use as hero background with high opacity dark gradient overlay (`bg-slate-950/80`) so text is clearly legible.

project_1.description: Blue robotic prosthetic hand. Perfect for 'Robotics / Prototyping' project card.

project_2.description: 3D CAD model rendering. Use for 'Mechanical Design / CAD' project card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and generous spacing (`p-8`, `p-12`).
Build the UI in React using functional components and Tailwind classes.
Ensure the modal scroll works properly: apply `overflow-y-auto` to the modal content wrapper, while keeping the background overlay fixed (`fixed inset-0 overflow-hidden`).
Use framer-motion for floating card effects, staggered intro animations, and smooth layout transitions.
DO NOT use raw <input type='date'> or <select>, but since there is no contact form, just render standard text/links for email and LinkedIn.
Enforce dark mode permanently; DO NOT build a light theme toggle as 'Dark mode by default' with cyan accents is the core brand aesthetic.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break out of it by using z-index layers, floating cards, and glassmorphism.
Never apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Only transition specific properties.
NEVER center-align the main App container. Center only when intentional.
Incorporate subtle micro-animations on all interactables.
Include data-testid on every clickable element.
